title: $900 PS5 Pro Sold Out in US Amid GTA 6 Fever
description: Driven by GTA 6 fever, Sony's $900 PS5 Pro is selling out across the US, with third-party scalpers charging up to $1,300 despite ongoing hardware boycotts.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Hardware Impact of GTA 6 Fever

As anticipation reaches a fever pitch for the upcoming release of Rockstar Games' blockbuster, the gaming hardware market is feeling the shockwaves. According to reports from gaming media outlet Push Square, Sony's supercharged PS5 Pro console is currently sold out across the United States as GTA 6 fever takes a firm hold of the gaming community.

Despite retailing at a hefty $900 MSRP, the most powerful hardware iteration in the PlayStation 5 family is experiencing overwhelming demand. Many enthusiasts are scrambling to secure the optimal hardware platform to experience what is widely projected to be the defining gaming event of the generation.

## Boycotts Overshadowed by Demand

Interestingly, this hardware rush is happening in the face of considerable community pushback. An ongoing blackout protest targeting PlayStation hardware has been organized by fans, with groups mobilising to keep their consoles unplugged indefinitely in protest of various platform policies and pricing models.

However, the sheer gravity of GTA 6's cultural momentum appears to be overriding these grassroots protests. The burning desire among hardcore gamers to ensure they have the absolute best performance for the game has easily eclipsed the active boycott efforts.

## Scalpers Capitalize on Shortages

The scarcity of the $900 console at standard retail channels has predictably created a booming market for third-party resellers and scalpers. Current market tracking shows that some third-party sellers on platforms like Amazon are charging as much as $1,300 for a single PS5 Pro unit—a massive and alarming mark-up over its official price tag.

Whether consumers will continue to feed into these inflated secondary market prices remains to be seen, but the initial supply-and-demand imbalance highlights just how intensely the market is preparing for the next chapter of Grand Theft Auto.

## Editor's Take

The rapid sell-out of the $900 PS5 Pro proves that GTA 6's influence on hardware sales is already operating at an unprecedented scale. While community protests and high price tags usually deter buyers, the sheer gravitational pull of Rockstar's upcoming title makes standard market logic obsolete. Sony and scalpers alike are reaping the benefits of this generational hype.
